mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS postId, p.title AS postTitle, p.content AS postContent, p.create_time AS postTime, p.user_id AS userId, m.name AS membername, up.avatar AS avatar, p.category_code AS category_code, pc.name AS category_name FROM post p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.user_id = m.id LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON p.user_id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN post_category pc ON pc.code = p.category_code WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = '1'

SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.content AS post_content, p.user_id AS user_id, m.name AS member_name, up.avatar AS avatar, p.create_time AS post_time, p.category_code AS category_code, pc.name AS category_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) AS tag_title, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pi.image_url) AS image_urls FROM post p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.user_id = m.id LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON p.user_id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN post_category pc ON pc.code = p.category_code LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN post_image pi ON p.id = pi.post_id WHERE (p.title LIKE #{kw} OR p.content LIKE #{kw}) AND p.status = '1' GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.content, p.user_id, m.name, up.avatar, p.create_time, p.category_code, pc.name ORDER BY p.create_time DESC;

SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.content AS post_content, m.name AS member_name, up.avatar AS avatar, -- ✅ 新增头像 p.create_time AS post_time, p.category_code AS category_code, pc.name AS category_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) AS tag_title, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pi.image_url) AS image_urls FROM post p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.user_id = m.id LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON p.user_id = up.user_id -- ✅ 关联头像 LEFT JOIN post_category pc ON pc.code = p.category_code LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN post_image pi ON p.id = pi.post_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = '1' GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.content, m.name, up.avatar, p.create_time, p.category_code, pc.name ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.content AS post_content, m.name AS membername, up.avatar AS avatar, -- ✅ 新增头像 p.create_time AS post_time, p.category_code AS category_code, pc.name AS category_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) AS tag_title, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pi.image_url) AS image_urls, p.user_id AS userId FROM post p LEFT JOIN member m ON p.user_id = m.id LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON p.user_id = up.user_id -- ✅ 关联头像 LEFT JOIN post_category pc ON pc.code = p.category_code LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN post_image pi ON p.id = pi.post_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = '1' GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.content, m.name, up.avatar, p.create_time, p.category_code, pc.name ORDER BY p.create_time DESC;

SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title AS post_title, p.content AS post_content, m.name AS membername, up.avatar AS avatar, -- 作者头像 p.create_time AS post_time, p.category_code AS category_code, pc.name AS category_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name) AS tag_title, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pi.image_url) AS image_urls, p.user_id AS userId FROM user_action ua LEFT JOIN post p ON ua.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN member m ON p.user_id = m.id LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON p.user_id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN post_category pc ON pc.code = p.category_code LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN post_image pi ON p.id = pi.post_id WHERE ua.user_id = #{userId} AND ua.action_type = 'favorite' AND p.status = '1' GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.content, m.name, up.avatar, p.create_time, p.category_code, pc.name ORDER BY p.create_time DESC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS post_count FROM post WHERE status = '1' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY date;
